links.comparator_used: Base breast density model (trained on a single dataset) used as-is, compared with locally fine-tuned versions at each hospital
links.outcome: Breast density classification performance of locally fine-tuned models, at the local site and on the holdout test dataset
links.effect: Fine-tuned models had mixed performance locally and performed poorly on the holdout test dataset. No numeric performance values are given in the abstract.
links.tradeoff: Considerable deployment burden: median 66 days to IRB approval, 157 days to install Connect and AI-LAB locally, and 216 days to complete testing and training.
links.quote: The fine-tuned models had mixed performance locally and performed poorly on the test dataset.

design_hint: local validation and fine-tuning before deployment
